source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-13

procedures.title: Parking brake rear cables (Corvette): remove and install
steps: Fasten the cable to the rear wheel flange plate.
Clip the cables along the frame rail.
Pass the cable end through the equalizer and hook it to the equalizer connector.
Adjust the parking brake (see Maintenance and Adjustments).
Lubricate the cables and all moving parts (see Lubrication, Section 0).
notes: Corvette parking brake shoes are covered under Disc Brakes (p.5-29).

procedures.title: Brake pedal: remove and install
steps: (Removal) Manual transmission: unhook the clutch pedal return spring.
Disconnect the clutch push rod from the pedal.
Remove the retainer and clevis pin to free the brake pedal from the main cylinder push rod.
Corvette: remove the steering column (see Section 9).
Corvette: hold the main cylinder from the engine side and remove the 4 support brace nuts.
Corvette: remove the 4 nuts and bolts holding the support plate to the bracket and take off the plate.
Corvette: remove the 2 screws holding the bracket under the instrument panel and lower bracket and pedals to the floor.
Take the retainer off the right end of the pedal pivot shaft.
Slide the clutch pedal assembly to the left and out of the support brace.
Pull out the brake pedal and all nylon bushings.
(Inspection) Clean the metal parts with a good non-toxic solvent.
Wipe the nylon bushings with a clean cloth only.
Check every nylon bushing for wear or damage.
Check the bushing mating surfaces for wear or damage; replace parts as needed.
(Installation) Lubricate and fit nylon bushings on the pivot shaft, at the right side of the support brace cutout, and in both ends of the brake pedal bore.
Hook the brake pedal return spring on the pedal arm, set the pedal in the support brace and index the spring in the brace cutout.
Slide the pivot shaft through the support brace and pedal bore.
Fit the retainer on the right end of the pivot shaft.
Corvette: fasten the bracket with the pedals under the instrument panel with 2 screws.
Corvette: fit the support plate to the bracket with 4 bolts and nuts.
Corvette: position the main cylinder, install the 4 bracket and cylinder mounting bolts and secure everything with 4 nuts.
Corvette: reinstall the steering column (see Section 9).
notes: If needed, remove air conditioning parts first (see Section 1A).
CAUTION: never clean nylon bushings with any cleaning agent.
Steps for the Chevelle and Camaro pedal return spring are omitted. See figure 24 in the manual.
